author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: सात्त्विकादिकर्मणां फलमाह ॥ कर्मण इत्यादिद्वयेन । विद्वत्कुलप्रसूतेन सुष्ठुकृतस्यकर्मणः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं दुःखगन्धहीनं फलमाहुः । रजसो राजसकर्मणस्तु दुःखं दुःखमिश्रं सुखमाहुः । तमसस्तु तामसकर्मणः अज्ञानं अज्ञानकार्यं च फलमाहुः ॥१४.१६॥
translation:
They declare that the fruit of the good deed is of the Satva nature and spotless, but the fruit of Rajas is misery, and the fruit of Tamas is the absence of knowledge. (16.) 
V. The good deed: of him who is born in the family of the wise. Misery: even happiness or pleasure mingled with misery becomes only misery. Absence of knowledge: includes all the effects of ignorance. (16.) 
A. The same is further explained.
